_comment: Specular / low-texture metal (reflective machinery, fabrication bays). View-dependent highlights and featureless surfaces break multi-view stereo, so depth comes out noisy: floater 'snow' and ghosted / melted geometry. Metashape honors these knobs directly; RealityScan's equivalents (image/depth downscale, depth-map filtering, a tight reconstruction region, masking) are GUI-only - see TUNING.md. KEY findings baked in here: (1) generic_preselection + a raised tiepoint_limit are the levers that actually align featureless metal (reference preselection has no coords to work from); (2) keep depth downscale at 2 (full-res ds=1/Ultra OVER-fits the specular noise and warps geometry); (3) do NOT crank mesh component removal - it strips real detail without fixing depth-level noise - a single light smoothing pass is the right denoise instead.
